hints.title: Value Overwriting and Pointer Skip
hints.text: Copy the value from the succeeding node into the current node and bypass that successor.

hints.title: Simulating In-Place Node Removal
hints.text: Without access to the preceding pointer, copy node.next.val into node.val and link node.next to node.next.next.

hints.title: Constant Time Node Splicing
hints.text: Overwrite the current node value with its next node value, then point current node next pointer to next node next pointer, effectively removing the subsequent node.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal constant time removal via node value copying.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Traversing from head is impossible because only reference to the node itself is provided.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Overwriting value and bypassing next node executes in strictly O(1) time and space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that modifying the node value mimics deletion without needing the preceding node reference.
